decision.reason: Two private adapter assertions reached their test bodies and failed at the immutable composed source. After one successful correction of an independently published reply, reopening loads the original body and the next correction submits the obsolete draft head. The real Content CAS rejects it. Existing passing transport stories do not exercise that second correction.

findings.confidence: confirmed by scoped adapter assertions and backend source
findings.title: A refreshed correction reads original bytes and submits an obsolete draft head
findings.brokenInvariant: An author returning to a corrected object must edit its selected acknowledged content and recover a current writable draft basis, without confusing another publication or exposing draft bytes publicly.

locations.detail: Fetches exact content using the global member-replies revision, ignoring the separately read selected placement revision.
Uses that global reply revision as expectedHead for the next draft CAS.
Load latest calls the same reader, so it cannot recover from this stale basis.

supportingSource.detail: Unplaced/global reply bytes are intentionally pinned to the identity creation receipt when no explicit selected revision is supplied.
Null-origin public read retains the creation revision; a Realm origin selects only its own placement.
Draft admission compares actual variant.draft_head with expectedHead and returns stale_head on mismatch.
stale_head becomes ContentDraftStale rather than a published correction.

minimalReproduction: Use an owned independently published Post or nested reply with originRealm null and an accepted Realm placement R1/P1.
Correct it through its own menu. Draft R2 and placement P2 are acknowledged; the global public identity still selects R1 by design.
Refresh and reopen correction for target R2/P2. The adapter reads the selected P2/R2 but fetches exact R1 and returns its old body.
Publish another correction: the request sends expectedHead R1 although actual draft head is R2. Content rejects stale_head. Load latest repeats the same global read.
findings.expected: Reopening uses the selected content and an authoritative current author draft basis; a second correction can succeed or recover an actual concurrent change while preserving local text.
findings.actual: Private assertions observed exact revision 22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222 while placedRevision and acknowledged next head are 33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333. The second draft request again names 22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222.

findings.repairBoundary: G-2840 should recover the selected exact body and authoritative current draft precondition through existing owners. findings.falsifyingAcceptance: At the repaired exact source, correct the same real owned Post and nested reply twice with a refresh between; verify the second editor contains R2, its CAS uses the current draft head, new placement selects R3 and independent readers/placements retain their own valid bytes. Add the two focused adapter expectations without weakening existing assertions.
